changelog:
BOUNCE — Performance, Chorus Wake, ESPHome Noise, Floating Window, Camera Vision, Stop-Word DSP, Settings Search, French, Direct HA WebSocket

Performance: wake-word C++ streaming cuts compute ~86%, inference pauses within 150–250ms after silence confirmed. Stop-word discards ML entirely: zero TFLite/ONNX/inference/GPU/NPU/memory, native DSP engine cuts CPU ~100% versus old model path, 27 behavioral tests pass all voices/gain levels, quiet room zero false triggers. WebView three tiers: High performance continuous, Adaptive full-speed while looking/easing off away, Power saver rest sooner/pause drawing. browser_power_mode HA entity swaps gears real-time, no restart. Together: same tablet runs wake, intercom, dashboard at lower CPU — quieter, cooler, longer battery.

Floating app window: selected apps open in draggable resizable floating window over dashboard. Independent virtual display, hardware H.264 decode onto TextureView, touch forwarded verbatim. Drag title to move, corner to resize, position/size remembered. One window at a time. Doorbell camera, recipe beside temperature card, calculator for homework, QR scan without leaving desktop. Requires Shizuku/Root, Android 12L+. Falls back fullscreen automatically. Tag apps with window icon in Minimal Launcher app picker. Path: Settings → Service features → Minimal Launcher → App picker.

Camera Vision Mod: camera becomes HA sensing hub. Live camera entity with front/back, frame rate, resolution, JPEG quality. Three on-device modes: Face detection (BlazeFace, up to 5m, XNNPACK, person detected/face count sensors); Gesture recognition (BlazePalm 21-point, open palm/finger count sensors); QR scanning (ZXing, HA tag URLs, last QR/HA tag ID/scan count sensors). Screensaver Person Wake: walk up dismisses screensaver, stay prevents return, walk away resumes idle. Mutually exclusive with Camera Stream Mod. Android 14+ JAR loading fixed: marked read-only after writing, checked before loading, existing installations auto-repaired. Thanks @scenix222 #197.

Chorus Wake: multi-device wake arbitration. ~180ms LAN arbitration combines wake confidence with real pre-gain sound pressure. Clearest/nearest device takes conversation, near ties rotate. Yielding device shows soft dim field with three breathing points, remains online. Winner broadcasts session completion 3×, others return smoothly. 90s safety bound prevents lost end packet silence. No cloud/MQTT/automation. Packets contain only identity/wake identity/time/score, no audio. Enabled by default, disable for single Ava or when avoiding latency. Path: Settings → Voice Configuration → Chorus wake.

ESPHome Noise: encrypted voice-satellite connections. Built-in ESPHome baseline 2026.10.1. Standard Noise NNpsk0 handshake: 32-byte Base64 key, X25519 negotiation, ChaCha20-Poly1305 protected channel. Empty key preserves plaintext. Advertises Noise support, requires encryption only after explicit key config. Path: Settings → Connection → ESPHome → API encryption key.

ADB Control gate: independent gate across inbound ADB/broadcast control. Turning off ADB Control ignores those broadcasts. HA microphone/wake entities remain in existing boundaries. Path: Settings → Advanced → Android Intent Executor → ADB Control.

Echo-reference bus rebuilt: reference-counted shared far-end bus. Voice satellite and LAN call hold playback reference simultaneously. Pausing one no longer blinds other's AEC. Multiple sources mixed in floating point, headroom at final readout only. Repairs nonlinear distortion from overlapping speech/music/calls.

Stop-word native DSP: configurable default built-in "Stop" (no model, no sensitivity), or swap any wake engine model as stop word with own sensitivity, or off entirely. Catches "Stop" across all voices/volumes, rejects hisses/vowels/running speech. Gain invariant 0.25x–8x. TTS residual overlay caught, residual alone never false-triggers. Alarms, continuous conversation, assistant replies auto-supported. Path: Settings → Voice Configuration → Stop word.

Keep CPU awake when screen off: prevents deep sleep on battery tablets, keeps HA heartbeat/Wi-Fi renewal on schedule. On by default, screen-on resumes normal. System auto-reclaims if process exits. Path: Settings → Service features → Keep Running.

Settings search: global search across categories, nested pages, individual controls. Navigates directly to correct level. Landscape split back navigation repaired.

HA WebSocket direct: Live state streams entity state straight from HA WebSocket without ESPHome callback wait, fallback automatically. Full snapshot on new subscription. Call via WebSocket sends quick-entity toggles/media/scenes directly. Signed-in camera/covers use HA login token. Bluetooth master switch disabled: can remove HA remote BT device remnants manually/auto, only entries routed through this Ava. Path: Settings → Connection → Home Assistant.

Keep Running page: boot auto-start, crash recovery, screen-off keep-alive gathered. ESPHome entry mentions API encryption key. Minimal Launcher alphabetic sections, fast scroll, edge fades. Icon-pack loading, widget dragging, drawer crashes repaired. Simple Clock Simple portrait and Portrait magazine layouts. Voice Message device search. Complete French interface. Screen control pure-black low-brightness overlay fallback without Root/Shizuku.

Fixes: Camera Stream RTSP accept loop before ServerSocket on Android 7 #196 @mclarenlm. Browser URLs preserve ?kiosk/hide_header/hide_sidebar #195 @Zhephyr54. MA playback groups stable identities, rejects foreign Sendspin groups. Software Update reuses GitHub data, CN/RU mirror racing. HLS playback, Minimal Launcher widgets/dragging, service-state card startup crashes repaired. Anonymous statistics off pauses Clarity, clears cache. Non-CN/RU locales use GitHub only. Thanks @Kayett #194.
